title: 等待
summary: 内容还没到，屏幕上该留什么？骨架占布局位子；空状态给人话和下一步。不要转圈，不要「暂无数据」。
summaryEn: While content is missing, what should occupy the screen? A skeleton holds layout; an empty state offers a human line and a next step. Not a spinner. Not “no data”.
